eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Maricopa, AZ; at 3:23 AM on AUG 22, 2024 Effective until 1:23 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Maricopa County. This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety. The Chandler Police Department is looking for 21-year-old Nicholas Flores. Nicholas is a Hispanic male, 5 feet 8 inches tall, 240 pounds, with black hair and brown eyes. He was last seen wearing a grey shirt and blue shorts and sandals. Nicholas may have a cell phone with him, but it does not have service. He was last seen on foot August 20, 2024, at 10:00 A.M. near Delaware Street and Commonwealth Avenue in Chandler, Arizona. Nicholas suffers from a condition which can make him seem to become lost or easily confused. If you have seen or have any contact with Isaiah, please call the Chandler Police Department 480-782-4130 or 9 1 1. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 911.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
